name: offsecskills
description: Security skills for Claude Code: deep, source-cited code review and more.

plugins.name: secure-code-review
plugins.description: Security-first source code review for any language or app type. Builds and confirms a role matrix, hunts broken access control and business-logic abuse, maps OWASP Top 10:2025 / API Top 10 / ASVS 5.0 / CWE Top 25 / MASVS / Agentic, and optionally correlates an authorized live app back to code. Read-only by default.

plugins.name: cloud-pentest
plugins.description: Authorized cloud penetration testing for AWS, Azure / Entra ID, GCP, and Kubernetes/containers. Phased engagement with a written-authorization gate, IAM/resource enumeration, privilege-escalation and lateral-movement path analysis, and a findings report mapped to remediation. Authorization-gated and least-impact.

plugins.name: wifi-pentest
plugins.description: Authorized Wi-Fi / wireless penetration testing across 802.11 OPN/OWE/WEP/WPA/WPA2/WPA3-SAE and WPA-Enterprise (802.1X/EAP). Phased engagement with an RF-authorization gate, monitor-mode recon, attack selection by encryption type, offline cracking, and a findings report mapped to remediation. Authorization-gated and least-impact.
